attempts.approach: Run the architecture-related focused suite including tests/test_training.py.
attempts.outcome: The repository has no tests/test_training.py; pytest exited before collecting tests. The corrected existing-file suite passed 139 tests except one compatibility probe, which was then fixed.

attempts.approach: Run the first bounded CPU vNext backend probe.
attempts.outcome: The hybrid zero-init error reducer called max() on empty vector/tensor outputs for scalar-only output irreps. The reducer was restricted to nonempty outputs and the 21-repeat probe then completed.

attempts.approach: Run the post-review related focused suite using guessed local test filenames.
attempts.outcome: Pytest exited before collection because two guessed filenames were wrong; repository discovery identified tests/test_gated_local_transport.py and tests/test_pairwise_local_content.py.

attempts.approach: Run the post-review full repository fast gate after adding packed-neighbor support to InteractionReadout.
attempts.outcome: One direct private InteractionReadout test failed because the new packed_neighbors keyword lacked a default. Restoring packed_neighbors=None preserved the private call contract; the targeted test and the 775-test fast gate then passed.

deliverable: A coherent opt-in vNext implementation packet, focused/full verification, updated architecture documentation and experiment ledger, and an independently reviewed Codex Science artifact bundle.

done_criteria.text: Shared feedback is mapped to current code and speculative or inappropriate items are explicitly excluded.
The selected architecture packet is implemented with default-off or backward-compatible behavior and no dense N x N hot-path tensor.
Focused tests cover functional equivalence, symmetry, permutation, gradients, configuration, and compatibility for the new paths.
The repository fast gate passes and any performance evidence is bounded to the measured environment.
Documentation, experiment ledger, provenance manifest, and independent review accurately state supported and unsupported claims.
